_comment: What each provisioning item actually grants -- feeds the human-readable detail sentence and the provided[] list on the Provisional Status screen. Keyed by agent_key (NOT by department: the standard hardware kit is identical for Tax/Audit/Law, and department-specific software names already live in provisioning_matrix.json). Overrides merge base -> by_department[department] -> by_item[item], each tier free to replace `provided` and/or `template`. by_item exists because IT Support has two items sharing agent_key 'asset'. Placeholders resolved in `template` and in each `provided` entry: {employee_name} {employee_id} {department} {software_name} {item} {external_ref} {username}; {provided} (the comma-joined list) is available in `template` only. Read at request time by services/provisioning_details.py and NOT persisted, so editing this file changes what already-provisioned rows report -- acceptable for POC/demo, not a substitute for an audit trail. Mock entries carry both `provided` and `template`; the functional entries at the bottom carry `provided` ONLY, because their detail sentence comes from the live connector, which is the only thing that knows the real identifier.

asset.template: Standard hardware kit allocated to {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Items issued: {provided}. Snipe-IT allocation reference: {external_ref}.

Asset Management (operational access).template: Snipe-IT operational console access granted to {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Access includes: {provided}. Console account: {username}. Snipe-IT reference: {external_ref}.

access_recommendation.template: Licence bundle recommended for {employee_name} ({department}) and queued for Admin approval. Recommended: {provided}. Covers: {software_name}. Recommendation reference: {external_ref}.

tax_preparation.template: CCH Axcess Tax access provisioned for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Enabled: {provided}. Platform account reference: {external_ref}.

audit_software.template: CaseWare IDEA installed and licensed for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Provisioned: {provided}. Licence reference: {external_ref}.

legal_research.template: Westlaw legal research account created for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Includes: {provided}. Account reference: {external_ref}.

productivity_suite.template: Microsoft 365 productivity suite assigned to {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Applications enabled: {provided}. Licence reference: {external_ref}.

network_access.template: Network access configured for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Granted: {provided}. VPN profile reference: {external_ref}.

ticketing_itsm.template: ServiceNow requester access registered for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Permissions: {provided}. Requester account reference: {external_ref}.

ticketing_fulfiller_role.template: ServiceNow Fulfiller role granted to {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Permissions: {provided}. Fulfiller account reference: {external_ref}.

remote_support_tool.template: Remote support tooling provisioned for {employee_name} ({employee_id}). Enabled: {provided}. Tool account reference: {external_ref}. No open-source remote support tool has been selected yet (PDD Open Item #7).
